title: Sneaker on Studio White
tests: Tests complete background replacement with seamless white while retaining white-product detail and a grounding shadow.

faults.what: The output is approximately 5:3 rather than the required 16:9.

judge.summary: The edit produces a clean white-background product shot with preserved sneaker details and a soft grounding shadow, but the aspect ratio is not 16:9.

must_haves.item: The same sneaker is shown in its original side view, fully inside the frame.
must_haves.why: The sneaker retains its original side-view orientation and is fully visible with margins around it.

must_haves.item: The sneaker's leather, laces and sole details remain recognizable.
must_haves.why: The leather panels, stitching, laces, eyelets and textured sole remain clearly recognizable.

must_haves.item: The grey floor and clutter are replaced by a seamless white setting.
must_haves.why: The room clutter and grey floor have been removed, leaving a clean white studio setting.

must_haves.item: A soft shadow beneath the sneaker grounds it without introducing a visible floor boundary.
must_haves.why: A subtle shadow sits beneath the sole, and no horizon or floor boundary is visible.

must_haves.item: The image is 16:9 with no added text.
must_haves.why: There is no added text, but the displayed image is 1024 × 614, not 16:9.
